harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd-managed service named inventory-worker on node1, running under a new dedicated system account inventorysvc, enabled at boot. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot ID and service health, rebooted node1 via sudo -n reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified inventory-worker was active/enabled and running as inventorysvc post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and confirmed no pre-existing inventorysvc user or inventory-worker service
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (no login shell, no home)
systemctl daemon-reload, enable, and start inventory-worker; verified active/running and process owned by inventorysvc
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline
Issued sudo -n reboot on node1 (ack observed as immediate SSH disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Verified inventory-worker was active, enabled, and running under inventorysvc after restart

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: No pre-existing user/service found; created inventorysvc and systemd unit inventory-worker, enabled and started, verified active with process owned by inventorysvc
Captured boot_id fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a and confirmed inventory-worker active/enabled prior to reboot
sudo -n reboot issued; connection dropped immediately, acknowledging the reboot command before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart / changed boot identity
evidence.summary: SSH refused immediately after reboot, then exec succeeded again with boot_id 0eeb239c-44d7-493c-8f44-62d52ab94a58, proving a genuine reboot occurred
After restart, inventory-worker is active and enabled, running as PID 858 owned by inventorysvc, started at boot via systemd
